summary: Node1 now serves a persistent local Alpine package repository at http://10.100.31.10:8080. The `tree` package was installed from tagged repository `@local` while both usual Alpine repositories were unreachable. Repository service, data, configuration, and package installation survived the mandatory reboot.
actions_performed: Created `/srv/apk-local/x86_64` containing APKINDEX.tar.gz, tree, and its dependency package.
Installed and enabled darkhttpd under OpenRC on port 8080.
Configured `@local http://10.100.31.10:8080` as an APK source.
Made the usual Alpine CDN unreachable and cleared cached indexes before installing `tree@local`.
Rebooted node1 once and verified recovery with a changed boot ID.

evidence.requirement: Serve a package repository from local storage
evidence.summary: The architecture-specific APK index returned HTTP 200 and listed musl and tree; after reboot, both index and tree APK retained their pre-reboot SHA-256 hashes.

evidence.requirement: Install a package while usual remote repositories are unreachable
evidence.summary: Shows tree initially absent, CDN connection refused, both main and community repositories unavailable, successful `Installing tree@local (2.2.1-r0)`, and functional tree execution.

Pre-restart boot ID and complete health baseline were captured; reboot acknowledgement returned; boot ID changed from 66ec4168-a48f-4bba-ad9c-40a6257ecf30 to 7809d5fc-038d-4de2-9832-07365e9c28cc; darkhttpd, repository contents, installed package, and outage configuration recovered.
